Create a new workflow that reads ./in/tickets.json. Each row has an id and a numeric age_hours. Keep records whose age_hours is strictly greater than 48, preserve their input order, and write a JSON object containing count and ids to ./out/report.json. Expose the selected records as the named output stale. Use an applicable admitted Foundry component when the catalogue provides one, with these exact paths and threshold bound; otherwise construct the same requested work. Missing catalogue coverage must not remove the report requirement. The request authorizes only the stated file read/write and the read, jq and write tools.
